title: Clean up my laptop with Claude
hook: I wanted to use my old laptop and it was really struggling to work until I actually got Claude to clean up my laptop
summary:
Metricool: scheduled Fri 2026-10-16 11:00 IG + TikTok
Clean up my laptop with Claude: I used Claude in the terminal to sort the files on my old laptop and my Google Drive. Nothing is auto-deleted: a 'To Be Deleted' folder holds files I review and delete myself. Comment CLEANUP for the command. Master: Drive > Reels for CapCut > claude-cleans-laptop > reel.mp4 (v8).
